entries.en: Michelle! Michelle, you here...? Michelle, say something! Please!
entries.ro: Michelle! Michelle, ești aici...? Michelle, zi ceva! Te rog!

entries.en: They didn't do a thing. They couldn't have. Your kidneys are acting up... Whatta they need sick kidneys for?
entries.ro: N-au făcut nimic. N-ar fi putut. Rinichii tăi fac figuri... Pentru ce le trebuie rinichi bolnavi?

entries.en: Don't... This isn't a joke, all right? Say something... Anything.
entries.ro: Nu... N-o fi glumă, bine? Zi ceva... Orice.

entries.en: I can find you that way... And we'll go home.
entries.ro: Te pot găsi așa... Și mergem acasă.

entries.en: I'll take ya to the movies like you wanted. Your choice! Just please... say something!
entries.ro: Te duc la film, cum voiai. Tu alegi! Doar te rog... zi ceva!
